rows.col_1: GET https://developer.api.autodesk.com/construction/takeoff/v1/projects/{projectId}/packages
User context required
data:read
JSON

Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a three-legged access token obtained via an Authorization Code flow or a Secure Service Account (SSA) flow.
The SSA flow is designed for headless server-to-server operations. While it functions like a two-legged flow (no user interaction), it is classified as three-legged because it preserves user context.

Specifies the region where the service is located.
Possible values: US, EMEA. For the full list of supported regions, see the Regions page.

The ID of the project.
This corresponds to project ID in the Data Management API, and can be specified in the form of “UUID” or b.”UUID”.
To learn how to find the project ID, see the Retrieve Forma hub and project ID tutorial.
The package index from which the pagination starts. This is zero-based.

The maximum number of packages per page.
Acceptable values: 1-200.
Default value: 200.
